The direct users of `FHIRResource` are in the vitals and form-entry apps. Several other chart apps read the same FHIR bundle entries without naming the type, so they would also be affected if the framework's response shape changed.

**Direct users of `FHIRResource`**

1. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/common/types.ts` (lines 1-8): `FHIRSearchBundleResponse` wraps `entry: Array<FHIRResource>`. Every vitals page and the notes fetch are typed with it.
2. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/common/data.resource.ts` (lines 561-566): `extractEncounterUuid` reads `FHIRResource['resource']['encounter']` and splits `encounter.reference`. This relies on the `resource.encounter.reference` shape.
3. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/common/data.resource.ts` (lines 231-246): `getPage` and `useSWRInfinite` are typed with `FHIRSearchBundleResponse` for paging.
4. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/common/data.resource.ts` (lines 309-352): `formattedObs` maps `entry.resource` into vitals and attaches notes via `extractEncounterUuid`. This is the main runtime consumer of the vitals bundle.
5. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-form-entry-app/src/app/form-data-source/form-data-source.service.ts` (lines 227-236): `openmrsFetch<{ entry: Array<FHIRResource> }>` against `Observation/$lastn`, then reads `entry.resource.resourceType`, `code.coding`, `valueString` and `valueQuantity`.
6. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-form-entry-app/src/openmrs-esm-framework.mock.ts` (lines 41-45): a local stand-in `FHIRResource` with a flat `{ resourceType, id }` shape. It does not match the core definition, which wraps fields in `resource`. Tests that use this mock can pass even if the real type changes.

**Untyped consumers of the same FHIR entries**

7. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-generic-patient-widgets-app/src/resources/useObs.ts` (lines 61-105): `filterAndMapObservations` and `getEncountersFromResources` read `entry.resource`, `code.coding` and `encounter.reference`.
8. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-growth-chart-app/src/growth-chart/growth-chart.resource.ts` (lines 33-53): `useObservations` reads `resource.effectiveDateTime`, `valueQuantity` and `code.coding`.
9. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-tests-app/src/test-results/individual-results-table-tablet/usePanelData.tsx` (around line 51): maps `e.resource` from `entry`.
10. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-tests-app/src/test-results/loadPatientTestData/helpers.ts` (lines 52, 120): reads `entry[0].resource.id` and maps `e.resource`.
11. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-task-list-app/src/workspace/task-list.resource.ts` (lines 103, 541): maps `entry.resource` into care-plan tasks and plan definitions.
12. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-allergies-app/src/allergies/allergy-intolerance.resource.ts` (lines 18-24): reads `data.entry` from the AllergyIntolerance search.
13. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-conditions-app/src/conditions/conditions.resource.ts` (lines 131-145): reads `data.entry` from the Condition search.
14. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-immunizations-app/src/immunizations/immunization-mapper.ts` (lines 66-70): maps `immunizationData.entry`.
15. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/components/order-stock-details.component.tsx` (lines 17-20): reads `stockData.entry[0].resource`.
16. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/components/order-price-details.component.tsx` (lines 18-21): reads `priceData.entry[0].resource`.

The framework's `FHIRResource` is defined in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-emr-api/src/types/fhir-resource.ts` (lines 1-26), with the generated docs at `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-framework/docs/interfaces/FHIRResource.md`. Items 1-6 would break at compile time if the type changed. Items 7-16 would fail at runtime only, because they access fields without type links.

I did not run the TypeScript compiler or the tests. The list comes from grep and reads only. The Falkon search covered the core repo; the other chart apps were checked with a local grep of the chart checkout.
